findings.title: Minnesota loses another birth center, this time in Luverne
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Sanford announced the closure Wednesday, but will continue scheduling births in Luverne through April.
findings.access_consequences: Sanford Luverne Medical Center confirms that it will stop scheduling deliveries after April 2027. Patients needing hospital childbirth services will have to travel approximately 30 miles to Sioux Falls, South Dakota, or Worthington, Minnesota; prenatal and postpartum care will remain in Luverne. Exact last delivery date not provided.
findings.affected_population: Expectant parents relying on local hospital childbirth services in Luverne and surrounding southwest Minnesota communities.
